author: blast goodwill
review_text: used esewa for past 5 years had amazing experience. The reminder to pay the bill is amazing where I don't need to enter details everytime. One small suggestions to development team: I generally use esewa to pay local neighbouring vendor sometimes miss to carry phone with me. You haven't included the option to save qr code, i have to scan everytime, this is sometimes difficult and when we have to pay from distant and I need to ask them to send qr code on whatsapp over and over.
